Messages.Author: Goratrux
Messages.Body:
1/ Lupo has one Gas-Powered Chainsaw and one Ghoul Retainer. Can he
strike with the chainsaw, press, then strike with hands while the Ghoul
"uses" the chainsaw?

2/ Same as above, except that Lupo has two Ghouls Retainers. Can he
strike with hands while both Ghouls "use" the Chainsaw?

--Gor

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Goratrux wrote:
>
> 1/ Lupo has one Gas-Powered Chainsaw and one Ghoul Retainer. Can he
> strike with the chainsaw, press, then strike with hands while the Ghoul
> "uses" the chainsaw?

No. GPC can only be "used" once per combat, by card text.

> 2/ Same as above, except that Lupo has two Ghouls Retainers. Can he
> strike with hands while both Ghouls "use" the Chainsaw?

No, as above.
